description_zh: 创建一个应用身份凭证（ClientKey）
kebab_example: aliyun kms create-client-key --aap-name aap_test --password bcfefe15-46f00000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateClientKey

parameters.help_en: The operation that you want to perform. Set the value to CreateClientKey
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的应用接入点名称
parameters.name: aap_name

parameters.help_zh:
Client Key加密口令。

8~64位，支持数字、英文大小写、特殊字符`~!@#$%^&*?_-`，且必须包含其中的两种
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en:
The encryption password of the client key.

The password must be 8 to 64 characters in length and must contain at least two of the following types: digits, letters, and special characters. Special characters include `~ ! @ # $ % ^ & * ? _ -`
parameters.help_zh:
ClientKey的有效期结束时间。

按照ISO8601标准表示，并使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ。

如果您未输入NotAfter，取值默认为ClientKey的创建时间加上5年。
如果您输入了NotAfter，必须输入NotBefore
parameters.name: not_after

parameters.help_en:
The end of the validity period of the client key.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard. The time must be in UTC. The time must be in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format.



If you do not configure NotAfter, the default value is the time when the client key was created plus five years.
If you configure NotAfter, you must configure NotBefore
parameters.help_zh:
ClientKey的有效期起始时间。

按照ISO8601标准表示，并使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ。

如果您未输入NotBefore，取值默认为ClientKey的创建时间。
如果您输入了NotBefore，必须输入NotAfter
parameters.name: not_before

ClientKeyId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues

KeyAlgorithm.description_en: The ID of the client key
KeyAlgorithm.description_zh: 加密ClientKey私钥内容的算法。目前仅支持RSA_2048

NotAfter.description_en: The beginning of the validity period of the client key

NotBefore.description_en: The private key of the client key

PrivateKeyData.description_en: The algorithm that is used to encrypt the private key of the client key. Currently, only RSA_2048 is supported

RequestId.description_en:
The beginning of the validity period of the client key.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard. The time must be in UTC. The time must be in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format.



If you do not configure NotBefore, the default value is the time when the client key was created.
If you configure NotBefore, you must configure NotAfter
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
